top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: RE-CITE: Staff needs to update the expired first aid and CPR training. Expired on April 2020.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was missing the hazardous materials training.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(B))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Infant play yards were observed to have loose fitting sheets.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Training records were not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs (26 TAC §746.603(a)(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The sign in and out log was not maintained.     Corrected at Inspection: The times and initials were placed for those who had not been sign in.

top_violation_types.title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Director was lacking current transportation training. The operation provides transportation.
